compiled_state.description:
## Testing Mode
UPDATE

## Story DD Coverage
- dd-1: Create plugins/dso/skills/ui-designer/docs/reviewers/visual-spatial-evaluator.md owning visual_hierarchy_legibility
- dd-2: Modify design-systems-lead.md: legacy visual_hierarchy → visual_hierarchy_intent (text reasoning)
- dd-3: arbitration.md with tie-break rules (pixel-observable → visual_hierarchy_legibility wins; intent-only → visual_hierarchy_intent wins)
- dd-4: 4-reviewer fallback when draft-5a skips post-batch dispatch
- dd-5: 5-reviewer fixture regression test

## Implementation Notes
1. Create plugins/dso/skills/ui-designer/docs/reviewers/visual-spatial-evaluator.md as a committee reviewer file matching the format of accessibility-specialist.md, design-systems-lead.md, etc. Reviewer owns visual_hierarchy_legibility (pixel-observable dimension). Emits JSON at same path/key shape as existing 4 reviewers.

2. Update plugins/dso/skills/ui-designer/docs/reviewers/design-systems-lead.md to:
   - Remove visual_hierarchy dimension
   - Add visual_hierarchy_intent dimension (text reasoning about intent, NOT pixel-observable)
   - Regression test asserts absence of legacy visual_hierarchy field

3. Create plugins/dso/skills/ui-designer/docs/arbitration.md documenting:
   - 5-reviewer committee composition
   - Tie-break: pixel-observable conflicts → visual_hierarchy_legibility wins (visual-spatial-evaluator)
   - Tie-break: intent-only conflicts → visual_hierarchy_intent wins (design-systems-lead)
   - 4-reviewer fallback path (when post-batch dispatch skipped): drop visual-spatial-evaluator, use 4-reviewer majority + tie defaults to block
   - 3-2 tie definition; 2-2-abstain definition

Tests in tests/skills/test-ui-designer-5-reviewer.sh:
- test_visual_spatial_evaluator_file_exists
- test_design_systems_lead_no_legacy_visual_hierarchy
- test_design_systems_lead_has_visual_hierarchy_intent
- test_arbitration_md_documents_tiebreak
- test_5_reviewer_fixture_produces_combined_verdict (mock 5-reviewer output → deterministic merged verdict)
- test_4_reviewer_fallback_when_post_batch_skipped

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] Unit tests pass (exit 0)
  Verify: python3 -m pytest tests/
- [ ] Lint passes (exit 0)
  Verify: ruff check plugins/dso/scripts/*.py tests/**/*.py
- [ ] Format check passes (exit 0)
  Verify: ruff format --check plugins/dso/scripts/*.py tests/**/*.py
- [ ] visual-spatial-evaluator.md exists with visual_hierarchy_legibility
  Verify: test -f plugins/dso/skills/ui-designer/docs/reviewers/visual-spatial-evaluator.md && grep -q 'visual_hierarchy_legibility' plugins/dso/skills/ui-designer/docs/reviewers/visual-spatial-evaluator.md
- [ ] design-systems-lead.md has visual_hierarchy_intent and NOT legacy visual_hierarchy
  Verify: grep -q 'visual_hierarchy_intent' plugins/dso/skills/ui-designer/docs/reviewers/design-systems-lead.md && ! grep -E '^\s*"?visual_hierarchy"?\s*:' plugins/dso/skills/ui-designer/docs/reviewers/design-systems-lead.md
- [ ] arbitration.md documents tie-break and 4-reviewer fallback
  Verify: test -f plugins/dso/skills/ui-designer/docs/arbitration.md && grep -q 'visual_hierarchy_legibility' plugins/dso/skills/ui-designer/docs/arbitration.md && grep -qi 'fallback' plugins/dso/skills/ui-designer/docs/arbitration.md
- [ ] 6 regression tests pass
  Verify: bash tests/skills/test-ui-designer-5-reviewer.sh
